subject: Renewal & upsell: hosted API commit increase and rate-tier alignment for Kartify
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@kartify.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal & upsell: hosted API commit increase and rate-tier alignment for Kartify

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the productive conversation last week. Per our discussion I put together a short proposal that stitches together the renewal, a staged commit uplift, and a rate-tier adjustment so your platform gets predictable throughput during peak campaigns. Key points in the attached MAP-Commit-Proposal-v3.pdf: 

- Monthly committed tokens: increase from 1.2M to 2.6M (phased: 1.8M first 30 days, 2.6M month 2 onward)
- Rate tiers: move Kartify from Tier B (standard) to Tier A+ for token pricing during the committed window
- Soft-throttle guardrails: automatic burst cushions + 72-hr grace for first month of uplift
- Canary window: 10% traffic on the new commit for 7 days with metrics gate for latency and error rate

Can you confirm: 1) procurement timeline (proc contact + PO cadence), 2) required SLA/latency targets we should bind in the amendment, and 3) whether Kartify prefers annual prepay vs monthly invoicing (there's a stepped discount if annual)?

If helpful I can run a short ops-runbook walkthrough with Marissa and your infra lead next week.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm procurement owner and timeline
- We finalize numbers and DocuSign link sent by EOD Friday

Thanks — looking forward to getting this across the finish line.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Rossi <elena@kartify.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Gupta <samir@kartify.io>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 11:08:22 -0400
Subject: Re: Renewal & upsell: hosted API commit increase and rate-tier alignment for Kartify

Jordan —

Appreciate the clear proposal. A few clarifying questions before we move to legal/procurement: 

1) Latency: we need 99th percentile <= 350ms for inference on our critical route. Is that covered in the Tier A+ SLA?
2) Billing start: does the committed window start at DocuSign signature or on the first day of the following month? We prefer month start to align with our ledger.
3) Burst behavior: can you confirm how overage is billed during the 72-hr grace (rate and cap)?

Procurement: Samir is our procurement lead — looping him in here. We expect internal approval by 6/23 but legal will want final pricing spelled out and a clear rollback clause in the first 30 days if there are performance regressions.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Product
Kartify
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@kartify.io>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 14:30:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal & upsell: hosted API commit increase and rate-tier alignment for Kartify

Elena —

Quick answers inline and attached a draft SLA workbook (SLA-Throughput-Plan.xlsx) with the P99/P90 targets mapped to their respective route classes. 

1) Latency: Tier A+ incorporates a 99th percentile target of 330ms for dedicated routes when a committed throughput is in place; we can surface this in the amendment. If you'd like a stricter contract SLO (<=350ms) we'll include a service credit schedule.

2) Billing start: We can align billing to the first day of the next calendar month after signature — that keeps your accounting clean. We'll include that language in the DocuSign.

3) Burst during 72-hr grace: overages are billed at the committed rate * 1.05 (5% uplift) up to the burst cushion of 30% of committed tokens for the grace period; anything above that converts to pay-as-you-go rate until the next billing cycle. We're happy to hard-cap exposure if preferred.

Discounts: Annual prepay at 10% off list; 6-mo commit at 5% off. I'll include both options in the proposal doc.

Jordan/Marissa — action items for us: confirm hard cap option for Kartify and produce DocuSign with two payment options. Elena/Samir — if you can confirm which payment cadence you prefer by Wed 6/16 we can get the contract issued same day.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@kartify.io>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 10:05:47 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal & upsell: hosted API commit increase and rate-tier alignment for Kartify

Hi all —

Operational notes for the canary and rollout (high level):

- Day 0 (post-billing start): provision dedicated routing and pin model variant to the commit profile
- Canary (7 days, 10% traffic): monitor latency (P99/P95), error rate, and cache hit ratio. Gate: if P99 > 400ms or errors spike >0.5% for two contiguous hours, pause rollout and fallback to existing model variant.
- Ops runbook includes automated rollback, KV cache reset steps, and a support-on-call schedule (we'll provide 2-hour on-call for the first 72 hrs)
- Data retention and logs: retained 180 days by default; we can extend for compliance if needed (add-on)

I'll prepare a short onboarding checklist and runbook snippet for the DocuSign package. Ben — please confirm the hard cap language and I will attach the runbook excerpt.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Rossi <elena@kartify.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 15:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Renewal & upsell: hosted API commit increase and rate-tier alignment for Kartify

Team —

Thanks, this looks good. Samir and I reviewed options and Kartify will: 

- Accept the phased commit: 1.8M month 1, 2.6M month 2 onward
- Opt for monthly invoicing (we'll re-evaluate at renewal)
- Request the hard cap option set to 40% over committed tokens during the first 30 days (we prefer a predictable exposure)

Samir (copied) is our procurement contact and will route DocuSign through our legal. Samir — please confirm procurement contact details and PO cadence.

Jordan — please send the DocuSign link and the onboarding checklist/runbook excerpt when ready; target kickoff week of 7/5.

Best,
Elena Rossi
Head of Product
Kartify
